# Read-only AGT structure view from declared data

Source: `docs/deployment-structure-view/index.html` (AGT-3349). Read AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md, docs/quality/design/style-guide-hard-rules.md, the frontend and tasks domain maps, and the Dossier sections Model, Facts, Visual language and Views and navigation before editing. Use each Dossier recommendation (D1 to D9) as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Use central `--studio-*` tokens, the spacing scale and existing components; no coloured left accent bars; both themes; reduced motion. Fixtures use role names only, never machine names, addresses or account names. Never edit workspace metadata or project folders directly; use the application API. Git ownership stays with the platform. This is one bounded slice; scope outside its criteria stays in sibling cards.

## Deliver
1. Add `GET /api/v1/operations/structure?scope=workspace|project:{id}&environment={id}` as a read-only projection. Join the connectivity manifest (`InstallationConnectivity.cs`, `Connectivity:ManifestPath`), environment declarations (`docs/deployments/environments/*.json` via `ProjectEnvironmentService`) and `project.yml` schema 2 artifacts. Return nodes (`id`, `kind`, `label`, `parentId`, `unitId`, `environmentId`, `project`, `provenance: declared`, `sourceRef`) and typed links (`from`, `to`, `kind`, `label`, `sourceRef`).
2. Extend `ConnectivityMachine` with optional `parentId`, `kind` (open vocabulary: physical, cloud-server, vm, cluster, namespace) and `location`, and add optional installation externals. Keep existing manifests valid; update `docs/operations/setup/connectivity-manifest.md` and the samples in `deploy/connectivity/` with a role-named AGT example (three locations, Studio machine, Linux runner host, home-lab physical machine with VM and four containers, GitHub, container registry, model providers).
3. Add a lazy standalone `StructureViewComponent` at `#/workspace/operations/structure` (parse in `studio-route.ts`, mount with `@defer` and a dynamic import), with a workspace explorer entry beside the Deployment dashboard. Port the Dossier renderer (`src/render.js`) to typed Angular: nested flow layout, host and container projections, levels 1 to 3 with per-node toggles, replica grouping, link attachment to the nearest visible machine or group box, numbered link key, outline tree, focusable nodes with full labels, keys 1 to 3, H, C, Escape.

## Acceptance criteria
- The AGT fixture renders one boundary, three locations, three machines, the home-lab VM nested in its physical machine with four containers (three nesting levels) and three externals in the host view; the container view shows the same instances grouped by function.
- Every collapsed summary equals the children shown when that box opens (unit test over all fixtures).
- The production build's initial bundle grows by at most 2 kB; the structure chunk is at most 120 kB raw; layout of a 200-node fixture takes under 50 ms in a unit benchmark.
- Playwright with mocked API captures host and container views at 1440 and 1920 px in light and dark under the task results folder; Tab reaches every node, Enter toggles, the outline lists the same nodes, no page errors.

Finish with changed files, checks and evidence paths.

# Observed status, versions and drift overlay

Source: `docs/deployment-structure-view/index.html` (AGT-3349). Read AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md, docs/quality/design/style-guide-hard-rules.md, the frontend and tasks domain maps, and the Dossier sections Model, Facts, Visual language and Views and navigation before editing. Use each Dossier recommendation (D1 to D9) as the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Use central `--studio-*` tokens, the spacing scale and existing components; no coloured left accent bars; both themes; reduced motion. Fixtures use role names only, never machine names, addresses or account names. Never edit workspace metadata or project folders directly; use the application API. Git ownership stays with the platform. This is one bounded slice; scope outside its criteria stays in sibling cards.

## Deliver
1. Join observations to declared nodes by stable keys: host capability reports (`RunnerCapabilitySnapshotDto`, host id, release, telemetry), link supervisor state (`RunnerLinkResource`), run-target observed state (`RunTargetObservation`), environment health checks, `HostReleaseDriftVerdict`, engine and gate state.
2. Add an optional container summary (name, image digest, state) to the host capability report so undeclared containers can be detected; keep older hosts valid.
3. Compute the difference states from the Dossier: matched, declared only, undeclared, differs, stale (per-source freshness window), unreachable by design. Add Health (default), Version, Drift and Load overlays; refresh every 15 seconds while visible.

## Acceptance criteria
- Stopping a link or host in a fixture turns its node to the stale or down state within one 15-second refresh; a missing metric reads as not observed, never as healthy.
- Each difference state has a fixture, a unit test and a screenshot in both themes; status is readable without colour (glyph shape and word).
- Version overlay shows the differing releases of the AGT fixture and marks behind-release instances.
- Undeclared containers from the new host summary render hatched with a 'not declared' chip; hosts without the field still render.

Finish with changed files, checks and evidence paths.

## Deliver
1. Declare registries per artifact (npm, NuGet, Docker Hub, GitHub, JFrog or another internal registry) with secret references for private registries.
2. Record each publish and run a cached control-plane registry lookup every 6 hours and on demand (D8 A) for versions, channels or tags and last publish time; surface lookup failures and staleness.
3. Find consumers inside the workspace from lock files (`package-lock.json`, `packages.lock.json`) and ownership mappings; mark consumers behind the latest stable channel.

- The chat library fixture shows three registries, channel versions, a failed Docker Hub lookup and a consumer two releases behind, in both themes.
- AGT's own `coding-agent-chat` dependency appears as a consumer at the version pinned in `frontend/package.json`.
- No registry credential value is returned by any endpoint; a missing secret reads as lookup unavailable.
